scope: DXF LIGHTLIST group-5 references inside AcDbLightList are captured as reference handles rather than self identities; true object self-handle uniqueness remains enforced. No LIGHTLIST graph output, DWG reference-role or native lighting admission is added.
authority: Autodesk LIGHTLIST DXF table https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2015/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-C4E7FFF8-C3ED-43DD-854D-304F87FFCF06.htm describes group 5 LIGHT references and group 1 names.
source: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored an AC1027 LIGHT/LIGHTLIST scene; ODA 27.1 converted the scene to DWG and returned DXF. The ODA DXF LIGHTLIST has self 0xF000, ACAD_LIGHT dictionary/owner 0x30, and in-subclass group-5 target 0x2F with name LOCAL_LIGHT. Source DXF SHA fa5d37197d271ab36ce268ecfddd942083a33c9b1a3b02411714c9fee0af3fb9.
baseline: The unmodified parser registers the body group 5 as a self handle and refuses the valid selected reference; the fixture-free ASCII regression fails on the first valid record. The source LIGHT group 421 is separately unqualified before the preceding LIGHT color slice.
implementation: In processLightList only, track AcDbLightList subclass; its group-5 references are validated as nonzero 32-bit handles and captured without self-handle registration. Refuse orphan names, repeated pending references, and a pending reference crossing a subclass marker or object boundary. For reference-bearing records require a nonzero matching raw/typed self identity, exactly two group-90 values, and the declared count to equal complete reference/name pairs. Common self-handle checks and legitimate empty lists remain unchanged. No public API or class layout change.
tests: Fixture-free ASCII/Binary input verifies target shared with a LIGHT, raw self/target, typed name, owner and ACAD_LIGHT pointer. It rejects duplicate self identities, invalid or zero references, repeated or dangling references, subclass-crossing pair, orphan name, count mismatch, extra count and missing self; a valid empty list and same-reader corrected retry pass. Base parser fails the valid selected-reference case.
physical_diagnostic: Remove exactly the LIGHT group 421 from ODA output solely to bypass the independent unqualified RGB parser. Source /private/tmp/light421-color/out/rgb.dxf SHA fa5d37197d271ab36ce268ecfddd942083a33c9b1a3b02411714c9fee0af3fb9; derived /private/tmp/light421-color/oda-rgb-no421.dxf SHA 3efbda60448078270e99f643ee45a8441dacbe49a9fed06e6eca98aee88649d1. Hash-bound audit proves the only changed tag and the unmodified LIGHTLIST tags. The candidate native probe captures the expected single typed/raw record but the full file read remains false at unrelated MATERIAL; this is selected callback evidence, not successful whole-source import/export.
commands: Compile tools/probe_lightlist_dxf_reference.cpp against candidate libdxfrw with -std=c++17 -I<source> -I<source>/src.
limits: No full physical source import or graph output qualification; adapter keeps retained LIGHTLIST output refused.
No DWG LIGHTLIST role-0 semantics or target closure inferred.
No drawing fixture or shared-tree edit.
integrated_validation: The integrated LIGHTLIST reference, existing reference remapping and callback capture, and LIGHT RGB controls passed 4/4.
